findings.title: Report output can overwrite a verified input while the command still returns PASS
findings.trigger: Run real gate with --out equal to the selected model's m.eventb source path
findings.observed: Gate discharges the original single PO, returns exit 0/PASS, then report::write replaces the source with JSON after the final input-drift check. Immediate report rendering returns exit 2/STALE
findings.impact: Destroys the selected source file and leaves the current input bytes different from the bytes associated with the just-returned PASS
findings.origin: Existing boundary defect, also present before the repair series; exposed by the final input-binding review, not a new SMT proof error
findings.reproduction_source_execution: Syntax-compiled only; not rerun after the two actual reviewer probes
findings.proposed_repair: Reject output/input collisions before any write. Include model sources, manifest and policy plus canonical/symlink/hardlink aliases in a separate task; retain normal output behavior
findings.confirmed_reproduction_scope: Direct overlap with a model source was executed; the broader alias/input matrix is proposed acceptance coverage, not a claim that each variant was tested here

findings.title: Outer Gate timeout can leave the project's inner tool process group running
findings.trigger: GATE_TIMEOUT=1, INTENTOWER_TIMEOUT_SECS=20; real CLI and version queries, controlled blocking rejection wrapper for Rossi export
findings.observed: Refinement script returns exit 2 after 1.172520812600851 seconds without a report; inner timeout supervisor, Rossi wrapper and its child are still running in their own group
findings.impact: Cancellation of the outer command does not cancel the owned inner tool tree. Remaining tools could continue computation or artifact writes after the run stops
findings.fact_inference_boundary: Running process states were directly observed. Later artifact writes were not demonstrated and are an inferred consequence of surviving tool processes
findings.limit: No false PASS was observed; the inner invocation still has its configured 20-second deadline. This is not evidence of infinite waiting or failure of the previous monitored-group KILL tests
findings.origin: Newly exposed integration limitation from nested supervisors, rather than an arbitrary external daemon escaping monitoring
findings.cleanup: Probe finally sent KILL to its recorded temporary process group
findings.proposed_repair: Handle cancellation propagation to the project's nested supervisors/tool trees in a separate bounded task, with real-CLI inner-blocker regression and explicit lifecycle semantics
